title: Log in and reach the driver workspace
description: This verifies that a registered driver can sign in successfully and land in the authenticated workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or phone field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the driver workspace is displayed

title: Register a new driver and reach pending verification
description: Verifies that a new driver can complete registration details and land on the pending verification status screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the personal details fields with valid information
Select a vehicle type
Accept the contract terms
Submit the registration form
Verify the pending verification status screen is displayed

title: Complete driver registration and reach pending verification
description: This verifies that a new driver can submit the required registration details and is taken to the pending verification status screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the full name field with a new driver name
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the CI number field with a valid CI number
Select a vehicle type
Fill in the vehicle details fields with valid information
Accept the contract terms
Submit the registration form
Verify the pending verification status screen is displayed

title: See verification status after signing in

Fill in the login credential field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the verification status screen is displayed
Verify a pending approval status is displayed

Click the control to check status again

Verify the review screen remains available
